question: In a family of 4 members A, B, C, D, E and F. A and B are a married couple. B is the mother of D. F is the brother of A. Who is the father of D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png] 

Step-by-step Relationship Analysis:

 

A and B are a married couple. 

B is the mother of D.

Since B is the mother and A is her spouse, A must be the father.

F is the brother of A.

Family Structure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f10acdcc44fd6154e1540f04292e41026cbd6f6ae5078a22a70b04f175a0dc2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd18ce686fddcf526812b1d9ddbb4f505d6bc1ca85676af38ca5e61161a96496.png] 

Thus, the father of D is A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
